title: Remove a Tipppper Pneumatic Cylinder (LOTO, side panel, gripper cover, air lines, retaining ring/pin, lower bracket screws)
summary: Safely remove the tipper pneumatic cylinder assembly for replacement by following the documented disassembly sequence and verifying the cylinder is released before removal.
when_to_use: Use when replacing the OptiSweep tipper pneumatic cylinder assembly and you need to remove it in the documented sequence (LOTO → side panel/gripper cover access → disconnect air lines → release lift plate via retaining ring/pin → remove lower bracket screws to free the cylinder).
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Perform physical lockout/tagout and the disassembly steps in the specified order using the listed tools and fastener counts/sizes.
safety_notes: Perform LOTO on the tipper before starting disassembly (manual references “Operator Station Lockout/Tagout” on page 2).
After removing the retaining ring and pulling the pin, the lift plate will drop a short distance—keep hands/feet clear of the drop path.
access_or_tools_needed: Physical access to the tipper station
Loctite® (listed as required tool for the overall replacement context)

access_required: Physical access to the tipper station
system_preconditions: Tipper is placed under lockout/tagout (LOTO) before removing any covers or disconnecting air lines.

visual_references.description: Figure 7-10: Pneumatic cylinder assembly referenced by the pneumatic cylinder removal procedure (shows the pneumatic cylinder assembly and supports the removal sequence).

steps.title: Apply LOTO to the tipper
steps.purpose: Ensure the tipper is safely de-energized/locked out before any disassembly.
steps.instruction: Apply lockout/tagout (LOTO) to the tipper using the manual’s “Operator Station Lockout/Tagout” method.
steps.expected_result: The tipper is locked out (LOTO applied) before proceeding to remove side panel/gripper cover components.
steps.healthy_condition: LOTO is in place and you can proceed with cover removal without needing to energize or actuate the tipper.
steps.failure_condition: You begin disassembly without LOTO, or LOTO cannot be confirmed as applied.

actions.label: Apply LOTO
actions.exact_action: LOTO the tipper (see "Operator Station Lockout/Tagout" on page 2).

stop_or_escalate_if: If LOTO cannot be applied/confirmed, stop and do not proceed with cover removal or air line disconnection.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 7.3.10.1: PNEUMATIC CYLINDER REMOVAL step 1: “LOTO the tipper (see "Operator Station Lockout/Tagout" on page 2).”

steps.title: Remove the station side panel (if needed) to access the motor
steps.purpose: Provide access to the gripper cover and pneumatic cylinder components.
steps.instruction: If necessary for access, use a 3/8-in. wrench or socket to remove the nine (9) self-tapping securing screws for the station side panel, then remove the station side panel.
steps.expected_result: Station side panel is removed (when needed) and the motor area is accessible.
steps.healthy_condition: All nine (9) self-tapping side panel securing screws are removed and the side panel comes off without forcing.
steps.failure_condition: Side panel cannot be removed because screws are missing/incorrect, or fastener sizes/counts do not match the documented nine (9) self-tapping screws.

actions.label: Check access need
actions.exact_action: If necessary, use a 3/8-in. wrench or socket to remove the nine (9) self-tapping securing the side panel then remove the station side panel to access the motor.

stop_or_escalate_if: Escalate if fasteners do not match the documented counts/sizes (nine self-tapping side panel screws).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 7.3.10.1 step 2: “If necessary, use a 3/8-in. wrench or socket to remove the nine (9) self-tapping securing the side panel then remove the station side panel to access the motor.”

steps.title: Remove the gripper cover
steps.purpose: Expose the pneumatic cylinder and air line connections.
steps.instruction: Remove the gripper cover by removing the eight (8) M8 button head screws.
steps.expected_result: Gripper cover is removed and the pneumatic cylinder area is accessible.
steps.healthy_condition: All eight (8) M8 button head screws are removed and the cover comes off without forcing.
steps.failure_condition: Cover cannot be removed because screws are missing/incorrect, or fastener sizes/counts do not match the documented eight (8) M8 button head screws.

actions.label: Remove gripper cover screws
actions.exact_action: Remove the gripper cover by removing the eight (8) M8 button head screws.

stop_or_escalate_if: Escalate if fasteners do not match the documented counts/sizes (eight M8 gripper cover screws).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 7.3.10.1 step 3: “Remove the gripper cover by removing the eight (8) M8 button head screws.”

steps.title: Disconnect the two air lines from the pneumatic cylinder
steps.purpose: Depressurize/disconnect pneumatic supply to allow safe release of the lift plate and cylinder removal.
steps.instruction: Remove the two (2) air lines from the pneumatic cylinder.
steps.expected_result: Both air lines are disconnected from the pneumatic cylinder.
steps.healthy_condition: Air line connections are fully disconnected (no remaining connected hoses/lines at the cylinder ports).
steps.failure_condition: Air lines cannot be removed, or connections do not separate as expected.

actions.label: Disconnect air lines
actions.exact_action: Remove the two (2) air lines from the pneumatic cylinder.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop/escalate if air lines cannot be removed.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 7.3.10.1 step 4: “Remove the two (2) air lines from the pneumatic cylinder.”

steps.title: Release the lift plate by removing the retaining ring and pulling the pin
steps.purpose: Allow the lift plate to drop a short distance so the cylinder can be freed.
steps.instruction: At the rod end of the cylinder, remove one retaining ring and pull the pin releasing the lift plate; the lift plate will drop a short distance.
steps.expected_result: Lift plate releases and drops a short distance after removing the retaining ring and pulling the pin.
steps.healthy_condition: Lift plate visibly drops a short distance consistent with the procedure description.
steps.failure_condition: Lift plate does not release after removing the retaining ring/pin as described.

actions.label: Remove retaining ring and pull pin
actions.exact_action: At the rod end of the cylinder, remove one retaining ring and pull the pin releasing the lift plate which will drop a short distance.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop if the lift plate does not release after removing the retaining ring/pin as described; re-check that the correct retaining ring and pin are removed before proceeding.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 7.3.10.1 step 5: “At the rod end of the cylinder, remove one retaining ring and pull the pin releasing the lift plate which will drop a short distance.”

steps.title: Free the cylinder by removing the two lower bracket screws
steps.purpose: Detach the cylinder assembly from the lower bracket so it can be removed for replacement.
steps.instruction: At the bottom of the cylinder, remove two (2) M6 socket head screws to release half of the lower bracket and free the air cylinder.
steps.expected_result: Cylinder is freed after removing the two (2) M6 socket head screws (lower bracket released).
steps.healthy_condition: After removing both M6 socket head screws, the lower bracket releases as described and the cylinder can be freed without binding.
steps.failure_condition: Cylinder does not free after removing the two (2) M6 socket head screws, or fasteners do not match the documented counts/sizes.

actions.label: Remove lower bracket screws
actions.exact_action: At the bottom of the cylinder, remove two (2) M6 socket head screws to release half of the lower bracket and free the air cylinder.

stop_or_escalate_if: Escalate if fasteners do not match the documented counts/sizes (two M6 socket head screws at bottom).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 7.3.10.1 step 6: “At the bottom of the cylinder, remove two (2) M6 socket head screws to release half of the lower bracket and free the air cylinder.”

success_criteria: LOTO is applied to the tipper before disassembly.
Gripper cover is removed (eight (8) M8 button head screws removed).
Both air lines are disconnected from the pneumatic cylinder.
Lift plate releases and drops a short distance after removing the retaining ring and pulling the pin.
Cylinder is freed after removing the two (2) M6 socket head screws.
healthy_conditions: Lift plate drops a short distance after the retaining ring/pin action.
Fastener counts/sizes match the documented values at each removal point (nine side panel screws if removed; eight M8 gripper cover screws; one retaining ring/pin; two M6 lower bracket screws).
failure_conditions: Lift plate does not release after removing the retaining ring/pin as described.
Fasteners do not match documented counts/sizes at any step.
escalation_guidance: If the lift plate does not release after removing the retaining ring/pin, stop and re-check that the correct retaining ring and pin are removed before proceeding.

Escalate if air lines cannot be removed or if fasteners do not match the documented counts/sizes (nine self-tapping side panel screws, eight M8 gripper cover screws, one retaining ring/pin at rod end, two M6 socket head screws at bottom).

screens_or_images.what_to_look_at: Pneumatic cylinder assembly referenced by the removal procedure (Figure 7-10). Use it to visually confirm the cylinder/rod end retaining ring & pin location and the lower bracket area.

source_refs.quote_or_summary: Section 7.3.10.1 Pneumatic Cylinder Removal lists the step sequence: LOTO tipper; remove side panel screws (nine self-tapping) if needed; remove gripper cover (eight M8 button head screws); remove two air lines; remove retaining ring and pull pin releasing lift plate; remove two M6 socket head screws to release half of lower bracket and free cylinder.
